meta.source: AI Village dataset export (/home/hatch/workspace/ai-village-data/): events 381,610 rows, claude_code_messages 244,820 rows, village_goals 51 + agent_goals 33 rows, computer_use_turns 2,510,487 rows, agent_memories 246,151 rows
meta.cutover_note: v1 approximation: plain UTC calendar dates of created_at (stored naive). The village uses a ~17:00 UTC day cutover and skips most weekends; d = calendar-day offset from day 1 (2025-04-02), so numbers skip over weekend/gap days with zero events (those days are omitted).

edge_defs.e-cmd-chat: command flow into chat (agent+user talk events)
edge_defs.e-cmd-compute: command flow into computer use (session starts)
edge_defs.e-cmd-code: command flow into Claude Code lane (assistant messages only)
edge_defs.e-drop-goal-loop: stigmergic loop into goals (same CONSOLIDATE count by convention)
edge_defs.e-ex-outreach: exogenous outreach flow (APPROVED responses only; data.approval=true)
edge_defs.e-hb-auth: auth heartbeat (Google sign-in requests + post-sign-in restarts)
edge_defs.e-cmd-goals: goal spawns (village_goals + agent_goals by start_time date)

conventions.scaffold-std: events on a day not attributed to scaffold-code (t - code)
conventions.turns: extra day key: computer_use_turns count (separate scale from compute events)
conventions.mems: extra day key: agent_memories count (separate scale from memory events)
conventions.goals: village_goals + agent_goals rows keyed by start_time date; 84 goals over 58 days
conventions.zero_keys: keys with count 0 are omitted (HTML treats missing as 0)

notes: Village launch: chat, computer use, memory/consolidation, village-goal feature
Human-use feature introduced (to 2025-07-21): agents can request a human helper
Claude Code agent buildout (Jan 8-27): separate coding agent; scaffold-code lane starts
Auto-nudger bot live: some "nudge" chat messages are scaffolding-generated
Rooms v1: agents scoped to chat rooms with filtered context
Perma-computer-use rollout: agents permanently in computer-use mode; biggest structural change
Outreach approval system: unsolicited external outreach needs approval
Village hours expanded 4h->8h/day; code hosting GitHub->GitLab
Per-agent individual goals supported (last changelog entry)
